name: Hyperithm USDC Apex
oneLiner: hyperUSDCa is Hyperithm's USDC lending vault on Monad; shares earn borrower interest and redeem for liquid USDC, with credit losses reducing NAV.
collateral: USDC in the Hyperithm-curated Morpho Vault V2 on monad, held idle or lent through its MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2; borrower collateral and credit losses remain local strategy exposure
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue net USDC lending interest and realize losses at NAV. Ordinary withdraw/redeem uses idle USDC and the configured liquidity adapter, subject to liquidity; force-deallocation and in-kind exits are separate, not guaranteed dollar settlement

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa) at monad:0x78999cc96d2ba0341588c60ccb0e91c6c33cf371 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x068f22739a5f8a5c84619d7f355b678d00707908 holds 7 enumerated Morpho market IDs. This intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedent classifications.
